newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAISIO STILL SURGING IN HELSINKI.
newsitem.headline: RAISIO STILL SURGING IN HELSINKI.

text.p: Shares in Finnish food, feed and chemicals group Raisio rose sharply on Wednesday, at first by more than seven percent and then putting on 19 percent, on a U.S. deal for its Benecol cholesterol-cutting agent.

At 1140/0840 GMT, Raisio traded at 570.00 markka, up 92.00 or 19 percent, in lively early early trade. The stock exchange on Tuesday eased its usual 15 percent limit on Raisio, and the stock advanced 30 percent.
Brokers said they were astonished by the surge, adding it was impossible to predict how much higher the stock could go.
Wednesday's peak of 580 markka meant Raisio had put on almost 10 times its value since it launched Benecol in November 1995, when its stock was quoted around 59 markka per share.

"There just aren't any sellers," said one broker. Another said the stock exchange authorities had again eased limits on Raisio, although no one could be reached at the exchange to comment. Later the stock fell back slightly to 560 markka.
